rule: A family here is dead: it is never retried under a new name. A test whose family is dead is refused by the runner. An open family may spawn up to three declared fixes (one filter, one cost/venue, one market) after a FAIL, then closes.

vol-band-breakout-cfd.why: 720 configurations, 0 positive in-sample; the signal is real (+0.15R) but CFD/market-order cost is 0.13R

limit-order-entry.why: adverse selection: fills the retraces that fail, misses the runners; OOS SQN -0.3 to -0.4

gold-session-breakout.why: 32 variants on real 5-min bid/ask, all negative out of sample after spread

gold-vwap-fade.why: no mean-reversion signal to pay ~0.3R of friction with; SQN -12 to -14

gold-daily-timing.why: no daily/weekly timing rule beats holding gold on Sharpe AND drawdown

session-zones-tp-ladder.why: the OONEE/'RADAR' recipe is the gold session-breakout family under a new name

fast-trend-crossover.why: SMA20/50 and crossovers lose to SMA150 out of sample on QQQ and SPY

dip-buy-as-book-signal.why: 2-5 day dip buys and hybrids as the book's timing signal lose to SMA150; hybrid 80/20 costs 3 CAGR points

take-profit-levels.why: full and half take-profits at +10/20/30/50% all lose CAGR; some deepen the hole

fixed-pct-and-atr-trailing-stops.why: fixed stops never fire (the line is the stop); ATR trailing stops and de-gearing rejected OOS

short-below-the-line.why: shorting instead of cash loses on every market; book maxDD -11.6 → -23.9

sma-length-hunting.why: 23 of 23 lengths 40-260 work; 150 is mid-pack — a plateau, nothing to hunt

split-sma-qqq200-btc50.why: best-of-25 pick, drawdown -20.5 vs -15.7, rank correlation 0.41 — declined by standing rule

ict-smc-concepts.why: ~80% maps onto rejected families; no literature; two mechanical features untestable without OHLC — 0 of 8 close-only features survive

cot-on-off-filter.why: lowers Sharpe on all three sleeves out of sample; context only

opening-breakout.note: the one open door: the proven vol-band break at micro-futures cost
